pipes.note: Both sealed ends remain intact. Two opposite turns lie in the broad-face plane. The supplier must approve this forming process and the finished transport capacity; the catalogue radius table alone does not approve it.

fins.note: Custom fin stack. Slot sizes are fit allowances, not finished solder or adhesive joints. Air distribution, pressure drop and production method need a physical sample.
